message: Maybe you'd like to come out and visit as we can work on my house together? Electrical isn't really so bad, once you do it a few times. For me, I end up borrowing a neighbor's volt meter so I can be sure to get the positive and negative properly, even though I don't know how much it matters with AC. Still, it's nice to do it right. I installed light/fans last spring and they have radio control switches in the wall that my niece described as looking like an iPod. How much cooler can a light switch get than that? What I had to do is put in more insulation in the crawl space, finish painting several things, put in quarter-round in the dining room and our bedroom and work on the back deck, never mind the yard and all the branches that fell in the snow last night. A homeowner's work is never done. When was your house built? Ours was built in 1928.
